checks.name: Rendered compact remapped keyboard and pad help name Q and L3 with sword release sequence

keyboard.text: Solo keyboard: Move: W / Up arrow, A / Left arrow, S / Down arrow, D / Right arrow · Swing: Q · Dash: Left Shift / Right Shift / K / G · Block: E / L / H. Mouse aims, left click swings or fires, right click blocks. Keyboard half 1: Move: W, A, S, D · Swing: F · Dash: G · Block: H. Keyboard half 2: Move: Up arrow, Left arrow, Down arrow, Right arrow · Swing: J · Dash: K · Block: L. Sword: press Swing / left click for a light swing; keep holding through its recovery to charge, then release for a heavy. Pickup weapons: Swing / left click fires. Shout 1-4 / 7-0. Escape / P opens the match menu.

pad.text: Player 1: Move: left stick / d-pad · Aim: right stick · Swing: L3 · Dash: B / LB · Block: X / RB / LT · Shout: Y · Menu: Start. Player 2: Move: left stick / d-pad · Aim: right stick · Swing: A / RT · Dash: B / LB · Block: X / RB / LT · Shout: Y · Menu: Start. Player 3: Move: left stick / d-pad · Aim: right stick · Swing: A / RT · Dash: B / LB · Block: X / RB / LT · Shout: Y · Menu: Start. Player 4: Move: left stick / d-pad · Aim: right stick · Swing: A / RT · Dash: B / LB · Block: X / RB / LT · Shout: Y · Menu: Start. Sword: press Swing for a light swing; keep holding through its recovery to charge, then release for a heavy. Pickup weapons: Swing fires. Menus: stick / d-pad moves, A picks, B goes back. Gameplay can be remapped in Settings. Recover a missing controller to its chosen seat. Faction Front keeps its separate bindings.
